name: A Tale Dark & Grimm
s: Hansel and Gretel walk out of their own story and into eight other classic Grimm - and Grimm-inspired - fairy tales in this irreverent animated series.

paragraphs.text: A Tale Dark & Grimm is a Canadian-American animated television series based on the children's book of the same name by Adam Gidwitz, itself a loose adaptation of the Brothers Grimm's fairy tale "Hansel and Gretel". Developed for Netflix by Doug Langdale and Simon Otto, the series premiered on October 8, 2021. Netflix did not renew the show for a second season. It was nominated for the Children's and Family Emmy Award for Outstanding Animated Series at the 1st Children's and Family Emmy Awards.
